skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 40% ATK).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on a target that is [Burn]ing for 1 turn (cannot take actions; only 4 characters on each team can be in a Stun-type state at the same time).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] on the target for 1 turn (cannot take actions; only 4 characters on each team can be in a Stun-type state at the same time), and a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 1 turn (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Attacking a [Burn]ing enemy deals bonus damage equal to 100% ATK.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Attacking a [Burn]ing enemy deals bonus damage equal to 120% ATK.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. Attacking a [Burn]ing enemy deals bonus damage equal to 130% ATK.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
